warnings: Steel roof truss detail (the unmarked 'โครงหลังคาเหล็ก (ดูแบบขยาย)' lines of the roof beam plan). No member carries a mark, so every entry has element_id null and element_name_assigned (section 0.2). Section keys follow section 6a; the '⊓ 150x50x50x4.5' family is not in the verified key list, so only d/b are keyed and the full designation stays in printed_as.

Truss geometry kept on the truss element (section 4 rule 4 exception): panel chain 1.25 x 8 = 10.00 between the column rows, 2.50 eave overhang each side, height 3.30 (+ 1.00 below to the roof-beam level per the section ก-ก level chain).

Only the callouts legible at this scan quality were recorded: the connection sub-details (ขยายรูปตัด B / C 1:10, ขยายแป้นหัวเสา 1:10: plates 0.30x0.30x9 มม., bolts 4-Ø3/4") and the roofing/timber items (กระเบื้องลอนคู่ 0.50x1.20, ไม้เนื้อแข็ง 1½"x6" @0.50, เชิงชาย 1"x8") are not structural members and were not recorded as elements.
